introduction: Amy Xiaofan Jiang’s design and production practice integrates worldbuilding, market and design-led research, and participatory methods to turn complex ideas into visual systems and shared cultural experiences. She offers brand and visual identity design, product and digital experience design, curatorial strategy, and event production. Working with artists, institutions, and brands, she develops concepts, shapes narratives, builds partnerships, and carries projects from early research through launch and live presentation.
